messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Non-wear time detected
parts:
Hi all,

Any of you know if is there any way to get a report of the non-wear periods detected with GGIR package? I need it to corroborate if the periods detected are similar to the periods reported by participants.

Thank you in advance!

Best,
Jairo

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Non-wear time detected
parts:
Hi Jairo,
This is stored in rout, see tutorial on g.impute function for more informaiton.
When using g.shell.GGIR the values of rout are stored in the milestone data (.RData) files that come out of part2.
Vincent

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Non-wear time detected
parts:
Thank you Vincent.

Another doubt related. I defined window sizes as default (5, 900, 3600). So, I expected data to be imputed just in case that window3 is reached, I mean, if the algorithm detects 1 hour of non-wear time, then this period is imputed. But looking at rout, I've seen some periods imputed of 15 min, i.e. window2. So my question is, Are non-wear detection and imputation done based on window2 or window3 length?

Thank you again, your help is very appreciated.
El lunes, 31 de octubre de 2016, 9:18:10 (UTC+1), Vincent van Hees escribió:

Vincent

The method entails a moving window of size window3 with steps of
window2. The window2 size will be imputed based on information from
window3, which is centred at the centre of window2.
